name: belauri_forward
notes: Real geography; synthetic emissions and meteorology. Forward simulations on the prepared Belauri region (data/belauri/manifest.json, UTM 32644, 33.0 x 32.5 km domain, 500 m / 250 m grids). REAL: municipality polygon (area-fraction mask), road / built-up / facility geometry (source shapes clipped to the polygon), external patch position. SYNTHETIC: every emission rate, the external onset, all winds (prescribed, NOT terrain physics); K, lam, H are nominal values. DEM/hillshade/slope are plotting-only context. Courant: u*dt/dx <= 0.3 (100 s at 500 m, 50 s at 250 m, u = 1.5 m/s). T = 8 h: u*T = 43 km exceeds the 33 km domain; diffusion length sqrt(2 K T) = 2.4 km (physical, nominal); removal lifetime 1/lam = 6 h.

sources.comment: SYNTHETIC emission rates (micrograms per second; 1.5, 1.0, 0.5 g/s) chosen so that the study-region peak of the combined field is of order 0.1-0.4 microgram/m3 at the default wind. Not measured emissions.

from_west_southwest.comment: toward the municipality from the border side (SYNTHETIC)

channelled_demo.comment: SYNTHETIC divergence-free flow (uniform wind + Gaussian eddy at the municipality centroid); NOT derived from the DEM. Mean speed 1.2 keeps the peak face speed near 1.5 m/s
